reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, leveraging well-known Cu segregation and lubricious oxide formation in Cu-containing alloys at high temperature, though the specific kinetics and competition with other elements (Ni, Cr) in this HEA are uncertain.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on the absence of the Cu-rich oxide layer and lack of improved wear performance.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful, as it proposes a simple, controllable treatment to enhance high-temperature wear resistance in a specific HEA coating, directly addressing the research question.
